The '''Pitrillistia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pitrillistia]].
